basis: Prostate is the tumor's organ of origin and has no axis; vascular histology alone does not establish cardiovascular organ damage.
Neurotransmitter synthesis defect with defining developmental impairment, dystonia and autonomic dysfunction; eye movements and hypotonia are neurologic manifestations.
Generalized adipose loss defines the disorder; intrinsic ectopic hepatic fat accumulation affects most patients (>70%) and can cause progressive liver injury.
Triglyceride storage disorder supported by metabolic ancestors; obesity alone does not establish damage to another organ.
Defining cutaneous creases and abnormal skeletal growth with advanced bone age; no evidence supporting additional organ involvement.
Progressive scalp hair loss with follicular and epidermal abnormalities; allergic conditions are occasional and separate.
HIV-associated CD8 infiltration prominently affects salivary glands; lymphocytic pulmonary infiltration occurs in approximately 30-60%; ocular involvement is less consistent.
Bacterial toxin blocks neuromuscular and autonomic neurotransmission; paralysis and respiratory failure reflect neural dysfunction rather than primary muscle or lung injury.
Insulin-producing tumor of endocrine pancreatic beta cells; hypoglycemic symptoms do not establish common permanent brain injury.
Lymphoid-cell malignancy occupying the eye; lymphoma warrants hematologic and immune axes. CNS involvement is not established across this umbrella.
Bacterial infection of the endocardium and cardiac valves; embolic organ injuries are minority complications.
Inherited deglycosylation defects; developmental impairment and central neurologic dysfunction occur in most reported patients (>80%); other organ frequencies are uncertain.
Defective bone resorption; anemia/marrow compromise, optic compression and hearing impairment each occur in 80-99%. Cap excludes neurologic, dental and skin manifestations.
Benign subcutaneous angiolipomas; the definition explicitly excludes infiltration of adjacent muscles, tendons and joint capsules.
Structural displacement of aortic valve cusps with potential valvular regurgitation.
Disorder of atrial cardiac rhythm; no additional organ damage defines the condition.
Inherited calcium oxalate stone disease with nephrocalcinosis; urinary oxalate and citrate abnormalities do not establish a systemic metabolic disorder.
Organic acid metabolism defect; seizures are annotated frequent (30-79%). Other neurologic features are individually occasional; hepatic enzyme elevation is under 30%.
Carcinoma arising in cutaneous sweat glands; metastatic sites are later complications without evidence of qualifying frequency.
Peripheral nodal dysfunction causes fetal akinesia and congenital joint contractures; structural pulmonary hypoplasia occurs in 5/6 patients (~83%).
Invasive urothelial carcinoma arising in the ureter, which belongs to the renal axis.
HHV-8-associated Kaposi sarcoma occupying the colon; no additional site meets the frequency requirement for this localized concept.
Malignant mesenchymal tumor arising in the small intestine; skeletal muscle involvement and infection do not apply across the group.
Inherited excessive eyelash and other hair growth; possible corneal irritation does not establish common direct ocular damage.
Congenital accessory cervical rib; most are asymptomatic, and nerve or vascular compression does not meet the 30% threshold across the concept.
